> Thanks Mark — looping in specifics so we have a single plan. Quick summary of options and tradeoffs:
>
> Option A — Reseller-bill-first (recommended in most CPPOs today):
> - ResellCo invoices Nimbus directly (consolidated invoice).
> - AWS processes marketplace charge and disburses vendor and reseller shares per CPPO settlement.
> - Requires reseller acceptance of Tax/Invoice terms and a settlement mapping (fee schedule).
> - Pros: cleaner for customer AP, faster reseller payments.
> - Cons: reseller needs to manage invoice references and may need GL-code mapping.
>
> Option B — AWS-bill-first (AWS invoices customer, then AWS splits funds to reseller/vendor):
> - Pros: simplest for vendor compliance side.
> - Cons: Nimbus procurement prefers a single reseller invoice for internal reconciliation.
>
> For Nimbus (they requested reseller invoices), I recommend Option A. Action items I need clarified:
> 1) Ben, can you confirm our fee schedule for RDD-4789 and any GL code guidance?
> 2) Lauren, once we pick Option A, can you prepare the three-party DocuSign (Reseller + Vendor + Customer) and include PO# reference field?
> 3) Aditya, we will need the Marketplace listing updated to show the negotiated committed discount and the CPPO terms in the metadata.
>
> I attached a diagram for the invoice flow (aws-private-offer-invoice-flow.drawio) that we can hand to Nimbus AP.
>
> Best,

Irene — quick answers and what I attached: reseller_fee_schedule.xlsx with the mapping we typically use.

- Fee splits: for this deal we're proposing 12% reseller margin on committed spend, 10% on overage. Fee schedule sheet lists line items and settlement codes.
- GL codes: include two vendor reference fields on the invoice: "Vendor SKU" and "Vendor Settlement Code". That lets us tie payment batches back to the CPPO settlement file.
- PO#: ask Nimbus to put PO# 22387 on the invoice and in the invoice line item notes.

If we go Option A, ResellCo must accept the settlement mapping and populate the Vendor Settlement Code per batch. Reseller-side monthly remittance should include the AWS Marketplace settlement id.
